definitions.full: H739. Ariel אֲרִיאֵל 1. proper name, feminine (probably, see Ew) Ariel ( lioness of El ) name applied to Jerusalem Isa 29:1-2 ,(twice in verse); 29:7 (so Ges Ew Che Di and others; Tagum De Brd Or and others say hearth of El , compare אֲרִאֵיל ). 2. proper name, masculine a chief man among returning exiles Ezra 8:16 . 3 מוֺאָב אֲרִאֵל 2Sam 23:20 = מ ׳אֲרִיאֵל 1Chr 11:26 taken by ᵐ5 RV Dr Sm and others as proper name, masculine , read two sons of Ariel of Moab ; RS Semitic i. 469 compare אראל MI 12 , altar-hearth (so Sm & So, and Dr Sm xci , see below אֲרִיאֵיל ) and translation ׳א מוֺאָב altar-hearths of Moab. 4 Ezek 43:15 & Qr 43:15 ; 43:16 see below אֲרִיאֵיל . **Du Isa 29:1 (q. v.) makes 1 = אֲרִיאֵיל , from אָרָה + ל afformative, hearth (not + אֵל hearth of El ).

occurrences.englishText: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.

Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.
